summary: Short 12 m line in dense bush on a steep bank, off the lane.
reasons: Treed bank, no pull-off or tracks

drivers.seclusion: Bush on this side, but dwellings 18 m (north) and homes either side of the lane.
drivers.access_and_room: The line sits in thick vegetation beside the narrow lane; no verge, tracks or vehicles, and the lane is too narrow to park in.
drivers.convention: No signs; no cars parked along this lane.

flags: Line is only 12 m, under a van length of usable ground
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over the whole line.
cannot_judge: Whether the DEM slope is inflated by canopy
